notes: «3-121» is the leading number, and «رضي الله عنه» and «عليه السلام» are blessings; all left out
«يرفعه إلى» is a gap (rule 8): an unnamed link in its place before the Imam, never filled from memory
The Imam is written inside the chain after «إلى», so he stays narrator; the saying «كان فيما أوصى به رسول الله» is his report
